notes.title: The Angry Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Please work[/h1]

Hi everyone, Alec here.

Dead has went through a rough patch last year, with FPS drops and peculiar bugs appearing. Well now, I'm bringing Dead through an [i]actual[/i] patch bringing it up to version 6.0.0.0

Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] [b]FPS issue fixed.[/b]
This was caused by a Windows Update sometime ago but a new DLL included with the game maker files should fix this.
[*] [b]Full screen issue fixed.[/b]
At one point the full screen function didn't work. Now, it does.
[*] [b]Alt-Dodge works[/b]
Alt dodging didn't work on diagonals. Now it does.
[*] [b]Unable to move in Puppeteer arena.[/b]
I don't know what caused this but it's somehow fixed so let's just roll with it.
[*][b] Added "Unlock All Bosses" modifier.[/b]
As controversial as this seems, I believe you own the copy of the game you bought. If you want to unlock all the bosses straight away so you can just enjoy the fights and try new tactics then that option is now available to you!
[*][b] Added "Angry Mode" modifier.[/b]
This removes the cool down between boss attacks. Once the boss starts attacking, they won't stop. This is basically impossible and is only there for fun. If you want more of a challenge and a new experiencing fighting the Great Spirits then this is for you.
[/list]

As usual, any problems let me know in the Dead Community forums or talk to me directly on the Milo Games discord: https://discord.gg/nrP9zmM

If anything is wrong with the patch you can roll back to the beta branch for the last working version. Thanks.

Thank you,

Alec ːdeadhuskyː

notes.title: Dead 5.0.0.6
notes.notes:
ːdeadlabː

I'm not proud about what I'm about to type but the Dead community is full of super kind and supportive people so I hope existing and new people understand. I want to be honest.

[b]I could not fix the FPS issue.[/b] I don't know what caused it and I tried so many different methods to resolve the issue, none of which worked. It's a total mystery and I'm going to have to take this as a big learning experience going forward with other games like Mini-Dead.

So, [b]Dead will be reverting to v5.0.0.6[/b] and, unfortunately, [b]I will not be able to update the game until I figure out this issue.[/b] This means any new bug fixes or features will have to reside in the [beta] branch at the risk of low FPS. [b]The good news is that Dead will run at a silky smooth 60 fps by default.[/b]

As far as I'm aware the only issue with 5.0.0.6 is the alternative dodge not full working when moving diagonally.

I love Dead and it really bothers me that I can't support it reliably. In the mean time I will continue to try and fix the issues and figure out how to best support future games.

~ Alec

notes.title: Beta Testing Going Forward
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28887838/96a89432f4fc30b04f0461092e892d5755e551bb.gif[/img]

Here is what's going on right now and what's going to happen moving forward.

[h1]How this started[/h1]
Back in version [i]5.0.0.6[/i] everything was perfect except that dodging diagonally with the alt-dodge resulted in funky dodging.

In an attempt to fix this I inadvertently broke the fullscreen function. God knows how.

[h1]Current Version[/h1]
The current version has functioning fullscreen and alt-dodge. However, I'm getting reports of big FPS drops. I've been assuming that my updates are working which results in my doing lots of Steam announcements to versions that still have a tanked FPS.

[h1]Going Forward[/h1]
I'm going to be working closely with community members to figure out what's going on. I'll be updating the[i] [beta] [/i]branch.

The plan is to keep working on the beta until it achieves silky smooth 60fps.

[h1]Last Working Version[/h1]
You also have the option to rollback to version 5.0.0.6 by applying for the [lastworking] version in the Steam beta options. If you're experiencing FPS issues, please download this version. It may have a bug relating to dodging but it's better than having a tanked FPS.

[h1]Worst Case Scenario[/h1]
Worst case scenario would be I am simply unable to solve this FPS issue that, honestly, I have no idea how it occured. If this happens I will roll back Dead to the last working version and leave it as that. This means updates for Dead would be effectively resided to beta branch.

[h1]Best Case Scenario[/h1]
I crack the case and we move from beta into the default version and then everyone wins! We got 60 FPS, fullscreen functionality and alt-dodge goodness.

Big thanks to everyone helping me solve this. I'm glad I can be clear and honest with you.

Feel free to join the Milo Games discord server if you want to contact me directly: https://discord.gg/nrP9zmM

~ Alec

notes.title: Update 5.0.0.0: The Big Balance Patch
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/6ec52d5c6397562d6d412ebc137048a7ba917c98.png[/img]

A quote from a community message.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/262e2b547ed1e0cbcbf0b86cc356033f601c307a.png[/img]

I think I'll take the criticism and do something about it if that's ok. The changes are designed to primarily effect Easy Mode. As always, your feedback and critism is important to me so if you notice something that you think is bullshit then let me know in the community messages boards, the subreddit r/deadthegame, email me at contactmilogames@gmail.com or tweet us @themiloteam.

[h1]PATCH NOTE TIME![/h1]
[list]
    [*]Progenitor's mutant is now pushed back further with blasts.

    [*]Only in Easy Mode, Vesicle now has a tell for his laser attack. A ring will close in on the player so you will know if the laser is coming whether or not Vesicle is outside of the view.
    [*]Vesicle now does two rotations on his laser attack in Easy Mode.
    [*]Vesicle has a shorter wind up time for his laser attack in Easy Mode.
    [*]Vesicle now doesn't fly upward as much on his spore attack. This will keep him more central to the arena and therefore within view.

:deadspectre:
    [*]Spectre now becomes visible when within proximity of the player in Easy Mode. This makes it easier to keep track of him and gives you a chance to react to his charge attack. 
    [*]Spectre makes a subtle effect when he's about to charge so you can see where he is coming from.
    [*]Spectre now makes a different bullet-hit noise to Eremite. This will allow you to distinguish who you're actually hitting. This is helpful when both are invisible.
    [*]Eremite now produces a small particle effect when she about to attack.
    [*]Eremite produces the same particle effect when she is hit with a blast.

    [*]Migraine now takes more damage. I felt she just took a bit too long to kill.
    [*]Migraine's tiny shell fragments now glow making them easier to see in the chaos.
    [*]Migraine's tiny shell fragments now travel a bit slower.
    [*]Migraine's lasers are now drawing behind her face instead of in front. Moving the laser location to match the eyes proved to be too difficult.

    [*]One criticism was how Puppeteer's eye sentries presented unavoidable situations when they couldn't be destroyed. The player cannot destroy eye sentries in Easy Mode. However, when the countdown completes the clock erased all dangers in the arena allowing a fresh start on the next phase. This plays a lot better in my opinion.

    [*]Totem's laser sentries can be destroyed in Easy Mode.
    [*]Totem will never do the same attack twice in Easy Mode to make him more predictable.
    [*]To compensate for these changes Totem now attacks more frequently.

    [*]Glass Master now produces a large ring around him when he teleports to broadcast his location if he's outside of view.
    [*]On his successive teleport attack he will now teleport further away and is a bit slower to give the player time to react to incoming spikes.

    [*]The Silenced will now wait a minimum amount of time before attacking. This applies to other bosses too.

    [*]Fixed bug on Scourge's sword damaging player when it spawns in.

:deadbears:
    [*]Eight Bears now stop briefly before charging the player as opposed to instantly.
    [*]Bears gearing up to charge or are charging have a red ring effect making them easier to predict outside of view.

:deadember:
    [*]Dying Ember in Easy Mode now attacks less frequently. [i]Only slightly to allow guaranteed stamina regeneration.[/i]
    [*]Dying Ember's sprinkle bomb now has a smaller cone of influence from a 90' to 60'.
[/list]

Furnace remains unchanged because he is bae.

[b]I don't know about you but I love patch notes.[/b]

Thank you all for your patience! Soundtrack is coming next week. You may have noticed that I hid the music tracks from the game files. This is because I'm super sneaky but also because, as much as I want to share the soundtrack for free, I want to respect the composer's work. Don't worry, I'll be uploading it to Youtube too and I'm sure someone will pirate it, but if you want the highest quality version fresh from Paul's PC then the soundtrack is what you want!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/460eb80cc0850ad1235f44943a929014fae49d69.png[/img]

Now go...go show Dead to famous YouTubers 'n stuff so I can make more games. Thanks a lot and have a good summer!

~ Alec

notes.title: Upcoming Things
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Alec here!

Thought I'd let you know about what's coming up and what you can expect.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

"Tough but fair." That's the key philosophy that Dead follows. A post on the community discussions has highlighted the moments in Dead where it crosses the line from "tough" into "luck" and that just won't do.

My goal is to make small but significant changes to make the moves and the bosses feel more [b]consistent[/b] and [b]predictable[/b]. You should feel as though every death is your own fault and that you know exactly what's coming at you so you can react.

I don't plan on removing or changing entire movesets but polishing and refining the moves, especially in Easy Mode, to be more forgiving. This patch might take some time but it will happen.

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]

The soundtrack is all ready to go. It just needs to be approved by Valve and then it needs to be visible on the Steam Store for at least 2 weeks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/72052e3982dda5a6c2ab45c2534b1f0eb6d149d3.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Bosses[/h1]

I will draw each one. I promise. I haven't forgotten about your designs. Some of them are gonna be pretty neat. Here's the newest one if you haven't seen it!

notes.title: Balance Update 4.0.6.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/3ed3cabadca35829d1f5b4bf0a5b2613a43295f2.png[/img]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

As more and more players play the game it helps to highlight what parts are confusing and when information needs to be given to the player. I have released a balance patch which should make the game more fun while keeping a good challenge.

[list]
    [*]Migraine no longer one hits kills. This was never intentional but somehow slipped in. Congrats if you killed her pre-patch!
    [*]Migraine's ring shrinking move now happens a lot slower. This should give players more time to react considering the move only happens later with lower HP.
    [*]Glass Master had a confusing teleport ability. This has been made more predictable.
    [*]Puppeteer's clock now ticks down faster.
    [*]Puppeteer's homing symbol attack is now more obvious and should reflect the damaging effect of the clock more.
    [*]The portal has a more alluring particle effect to make it more inticing.
    [*]Real Puppeteer takes slightly more damage.
    [*]Puppeteer no longer decides to end its own life if you die on the clock. Puppeteer wants to live and you are not helping!
[/list]

Puppeteer has proven to be the most confusing of all bosses. Hopefully a faster clock turn around and more graphical polish will make him clearer.

Thank you for playing and the game will continue to evolve if needed.

The truth is game development isn't a very lucrative hobby these days. Steam is over saturated with games and indie game development has never been easier. If you don't have some sort of following or hype prior to a games release it will flop and be lost to the annals of Steam.

So that's what I'll be doing now! I'll try to get people to take a look and see gain some interest. If anyone has ideas or opinions let me know.


Big thanks to anyone who's kept their eye on Dead! You're the reason it's alive.

notes.title: New Game+
notes.notes:
Dead has a New Game+.

In a way.

It has New Game modifiers. After completing the game you will be given the option to toggle on and switch about some options for when you start a new game. All of these options make the game harder.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/96a89432f4fc30b04f0461092e892d5755e551bb.gif[/img]

[b]But isn't Dead hard already?[/b]

Yes.

In a way.

Dead is not meant to be stupid hard like those annoying "Impossible Platformers" made in Flash. Dead is just meant to be a good challenge. But, if you're the sort of person that DOES want to be tested to the limit then these new game modifiers are for you.

Turning [b]one[/b] on will be hard enough. Turning all of them on will make a challenge fit only for Koreans.

[i]Shout out to the three or four people commenting on these journals.[/i]

notes.title: The Achievements in Dead Aren't Rubbish
notes.notes:
I'd like to talk about the achievements in Dead.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/9639de57a3ef49a01de1a65837715f90dd9f2d70.png[/img]

I've made sure that each achievement brings something new. Nothing silly like "Kill 10 Rats" but instead, new challenges and interesting ways of killing bosses. 

[b]In other words these achievements are not a waste of your time.[/b]

For example, one achievement is to kill a particular boss without using your self-combustion ability. A harder challenge is to kill the same boss without moving!

There are medium and hard achievements for every boss in the game if you find Dead to be too easy.

I also make sure to complete every achievement personally (except for the hardest one, which you can see above on the right)

If you followed the Greenlight campaign [i](rip)[/i] then you'll know it's been a long time since any information has come out.

But I'm happy to say that [b]Dead[/b] is far from dead!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28887838/e4b3b0065ee34c66aa023dddce03f624a0e227c0.png[/img]

Ever since the release of OESE a year ago I've been working hard to make sure Dead is super fun. I dunno about you but I like my games to be fun so that's what I've been doing.

More news to come! Dead is shaping up nicely!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RXtxC1Nqr_I
